array.string: while true; do IP=$(/sbin/ifconfig bridge0 2>/dev/null | awk '/inet /{print $2}'); if [[ "$IP" != "192.168.2.2" ]]; then /sbin/ifconfig bridge0 192.168.2.2 netmask 255.255.255.0 2>/dev/null && echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] bridge0 set to 192.168.2.2 (was: ${IP:-NONE})" >> /Users/akmacks/Library/Logs/BridgeRestore/bridge-ip.log; fi; sleep 20; done
